items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: I heard guys talk about that, like Johnny Law and Tony Sparbo and different guys talk about going and playing prize fights between the rounds.

ctx.x: I got all kinds. I would parade on the... You paraded, huh? Oh, yes. I paraded. I played all kinds of jobs. So you got around.

Did you ever play any prize fights? No. Never played prize fights. I heard guys talk about that, like Johnny Law and Tony Sparbo and different guys talk about going and playing prize fights between the rounds. Yeah. But I never saw that.
No, I never threw around with that at all.
